role: notch-plane geometry, material constants, and source SIF/friction map for the anti-plane (Mode III) inverse setup (I-E1-E2 payload)
notch_plane: the through-thickness ANBD double-notch plane; the crack path is KNOWN and coplanar with the notch plane (source C1 coplanarity). Anti-plane (Mode III) shear acts along this plane; tau_III(delta_III) is the cohesive traction-separation law to identify.

material.rock: feldspathic sandstone (Baxi-01 host rock; Sichuan mountain-tunnel host rock context)

frictionless_FE_Y_III.note: bedding-independent in the source FE; per facts_index this is a relax_with_named_limit toward a bedding-dependent Y_III(beta) (source OQ3).

source_SIF.K_I: K_I = P/(R sqrt(2 pi t)) Y_I
source_SIF.K_III: K_III = P/(R sqrt(2 pi t)) Y_III

governing_physics.equilibrium: anti-plane equilibrium grad . tau = 0 with tau_III = tau_III(delta_III) along the notch plane

provenance.reference_project: Baxi-01 ANBD Mode-III fracture data warehouse (BJTU group own-work)
